1.title: Appeals Court Upholds Blocks on Trump Order Restricting Mail Voting
1.summary: The ruling on Saturday was the latest rebuke to President Trump’s attacks on mail-in voting. The government says it may take the case to the Supreme Court.

2.title: Trump Holds Off on Major War Escalation Against Iran as Advisers Raise Concerns
2.summary: Among the worries is that expanded hostilities could dangerously drain the diminished stockpile of air defense munitions in the Middle East.

3.title: Troy Jackson Picked to Replace Platner as Democratic Nominee in Maine Senate Race
3.summary: Mr. Jackson, a progressive former State Senate president, clinched the nomination at a hastily arranged state party convention.

4.title: More than 300,000 flee wildfires in France and Spain
4.summary: Spain's PM warns of "complex hours" ahead as authorities in France say they are far from bringing blazes burning near Bordeaux under control.

5.title: Iran War Live Updates: U.S.-Iran Strikes Abate, but Supporters of Both Sides Exchange Attacks
5.summary: The Houthis and Saudi-led forces in Yemen said they had traded strikes, and Ukraine said it struck a ship carrying Russian military supplies to Iran.

6.title: Wildfire Smoke Chokes Skies in Spain and France
6.summary: Hundreds of thousands of people, residents as well as vacationers, were forced to evacuate or told to remain indoors.
